summary: Static code review of HelpSOS.tsx keyboard-handling fix (Partner Help chat input above Android keyboard). Found and fixed a CRITICAL bug: the entire keyboard-handling block (useWindowDimensions, kbH state, Keyboard listeners, scroll effect, androidKb, sheetH) was duplicated inside the component body, causing 5 TypeScript redeclaration errors (TS2451 for winH, kbH, setKbH, androidKb, sheetH) and runtime double-registration of Keyboard listeners / double setState per keyboard event. After removing the duplicate block, `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` reports zero errors in HelpSOS.tsx (only unrelated pre-existing errors remain in other files). Note: /app/PartnerApp/src/components/partner/HelpSOS.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/partner/HelpSOS.tsx are hard-linked (same inode 525964), so the single edit fixed both. Logic review of the (now de-duplicated) fix: correct — Android uses keyboardDidShow/Hide, iOS uses keyboardWillShow/Hide; androidKb is 0 on iOS so KeyboardAvoidingView behavior='padding' does not double-pad; sheetH = min(85% window, window - androidKb - insets.top - 16) keeps header+messages+input visible above keyboard; input bar paddingBottom = 12 + (kbH ? 0 : insets.bottom) correctly drops safe-area inset while keyboard is up and restores it when keyboard closes. Modal has statusBarTranslucent as required for edge-to-edge Android. No regressions to send, attach photo, close, or typing-indicator paths.

Pre-existing (out-of-scope) TS errors remain in: HomeBanners.tsx (rose700), MaidTasksCard.tsx & subscriptions.tsx (icon name 'map-pin'), verification.tsx, invoiceActions.ts, webPush.ts, RealtimeContext.tsx, AppTabBar.tsx, BankKycScreen.tsx, AdditionalWork.tsx, starter-kit.tsx, permissions.tsx, job/[id].tsx — not caused by this change but worth tracking.
tsconfig uses deprecated baseUrl; TS 7.0 will remove it. Consider adding '"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"' or migrating to 'paths' without baseUrl.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL (fixed): Duplicated 11-line keyboard-handling block in HelpSOS.tsx caused TS2451 redeclaration errors and would have double-registered Keyboard listeners, scheduled duplicate scrollToEnd timers, and caused double re-renders on every keystroke-driven keyboard event.
Logic OK: Keyboard event names are platform-correct (iOS=Will*, Android=Did*); androidKb gating prevents double padding on iOS where KeyboardAvoidingView already uses behavior='padding'.
Minor: `useEffect(() => { if (kbH) setTimeout(...) }, [kbH])` leaks the timer on unmount; consider clearing it in the cleanup. Not a crash, just hygiene.
